channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Bhubaneswar Tea Seller Donates All New Year Earnings, Half January Income for 10 Years to Aid Slum Kids, Disabled
item.description: Shiba Shankar Jena, a Bhubaneswar tea seller, has donated his New Year's and half-January earnings for a decade to fund books, wheelchairs, food, and 18 dustbins for the community.

item.title: Finland PM Proposes Four-Day Workweek So People Can Spend More Time with Family and Pursue Happiness
item.description: Former PM Sanna Marin champions a four-day workweek to value time as much as money, inspiring global talks on work-life balance without sacrificing productivity.

item.title: Karnataka HC Halts Govt’s One-Day Monthly Menstrual Leave Policy for Women Employees
item.description: The Karnataka HC has stayed the state government’s notification granting one day of paid menstrual leave per month for women.

item.title: Woman Cop Warns TVK’s Bussy Anand: No Unpassed Volunteers at Vijay’s 5,000-Cap Puducherry Rally Post-Karur 41 Deaths
item.description: Amid Karur stampede scars, Puducherry police enforced QR passes and detained an armed man at Vijay's debut TVK rally, ensuring safety for 5,000 attendees.

item.title: Around 200 Nurses Detained in Dehradun as Protest Over Seniority, Age Relaxation and Exam Withdrawal Escalates
item.description: Around 200 unemployed nursing officers were detained by police in Dehradun on December 8 while marching to CM Pushkar Singh Dhami's residence, demanding year-wise recruitment amid unfulfilled promises and exam irregularities

item.title: Ratnagiri’s 21-Month-Old Veda Sarfare Swims 100 Metres in 10:08, Becomes Youngest in India Book of Records
item.description: At just 21 months, Veda Paresh Sarfare from Ratnagiri swam 100 metres in 10 minutes 8 seconds after 11 months of training, earning a spot in the India Book of Records as India's youngest swimmer.

item.title: Goa Nightclub Fire Kills 25 as CM Orders Demolition of Luthra Brothers’ Illegal Vagator Shack Amid Manhunt
item.description: After a deadly fire at their Arpora nightclub claimed 25 lives, Goa authorities demolished the Luthra brothers' Romeo Lane Vagator shack while issuing an Interpol Blue Corner Notice for the absconding owners.

item.title: ‘Iron Rod Inserted Into Private Parts’: Seven-Year-Old Girl Allegedly Raped, Brutally Assaulted in Gujarat, Accused Arrested
item.description: A 7-year-old girl from Dahod allegedly suffered a horrific rape and assault with a one-foot iron rod; Accused arrested.

item.title: PTI Claims Water Cannons Used on Imran Khan’s Sisters Protesting Outside Rawalpindi’s Adiala Jail in Pakistan
item.description: Pakistan's political tensions boiled over as police used water cannons to break up a sit-in by Imran Khan's sisters outside Adiala Jail.

item.title: Headless Body of Woman Sparks Unrest Between Odisha Villages; Internet Suspended, Several Houses Torched
item.description: Clashes between two communities in Odisha's Malkangiri erupted over 51-year-old Lake Padiami's headless body, as per reports.
